title: Hashicorp Security Advisories - 2026-10-26
description:
Merged 5 hashicorp security advisories published on 2026-10-26. Original advisory IDs: HCSEC-2026-50, HCSEC-2026-49, HCSEC-2026-48, HCSEC-2026-47, HCSEC-2026-46

Titles:
- HCSEC-2026-50 - Consul-k8s vulnerable to a cross-namespace authorization bypass in component ACL binding rules
- HCSEC-2026-49 - Consul vulnerable to an authorization bypass in health check registration
- HCSEC-2026-48 - Consul vulnerable to a denial of service in HTTP APIs
- HCSEC-2026-47 - Consul vulnerable to an authorization bypass in service mesh registration
- HCSEC-2026-46 - Consul vulnerable to an authorization bypass in the agent's service mesh leaf certificate API
